name: mc1_rooftops
description: Busy-region shadow cost split (2026-11-16). The owner logs in at home (-StartRegion) and teleports to the busy region (-BusyRegion, Rooftops at the 'TT Rooftops dark' altitude) when the pop-up asks; after settling, two views (camera still; camera turning at 10 deg/s) are each measured with three shadow variants back to back: all shadows (RenderShadowDetail 2), sun/moon only (1), none (0). Every run is a 60 s Tracy capture plus the frame rate from the FrameCounters log lines. No teleports, no separate fps probe.

owner_teleport.ready_message: Teleport to the busy region now (Rooftops, at the 'TT Rooftops dark' altitude), then leave the viewer alone until the 'Session done' pop-up (about 15 minutes).
